title: Refuse an acceptance that cannot be re-run, and record why work is abandoned
goal: Two holes from the lying-agent review: (1) a new task can declare an acceptance that proves nothing (a script written by the same task, or a command that verifies the host), and CI must refuse it server-side; (2) releasing a claim on unfinished, unmerged work is silent — make it a recorded abandonment with a reason.
